title: 第1974章 药园小酌第1373章 爷爷不公平
slug: 太古神墟第1974章药园小酌
content_zh:
第1974章药园小酌
落尘坦言耀小溪便是他与蜃丫的亲生女儿。
赢天竖起大拇指，由衷感叹：
“血脉这东西不服不行，果然虎父无犬女，再加上神帝公主。
小溪小小年纪便身怀逆天底蕴，这般资质，不愧是你俩的血脉。”
落尘眼底藏着几分温柔的宠溺：
“小溪天资冠绝同辈，无可挑剔。
只是蜃丫素来心软，独自带孩子难免娇惯
也让小溪任性执拗、天不怕地不怕。”
“这丫头六岁时，便敢孤身硬闯龙皇宫，看见什么奇珍异宝、绝世灵物，都非要一探究竟。闯了祸还总能振振有词，张口便是天玄人人平等，龙皇宫的至宝资源，众生共有，自然也该有她一份。
几番折腾，龙皇都被她闹得无可奈何。”
赢天心生好奇：
“龙皇可知晓她的真实身份？”
落尘轻轻摇头：
“并不知晓。除却除了咱们这个修行层次，世间无人能看透我子嗣的本源血脉。
龙皇只当她是天生的绝世妖孽，心中格外偏爱，还将她认作干孙女。”
赢天朗声一笑：
“哈哈，倒是一桩趣事。”
“好在龙皇本就是你的岳父，辈分终究没乱套。
倒是这小丫头，见着黄大牙、肖战一众前辈便张口喊爷爷，倒是把你辈分弄低了。”

落尘笑笑：
“辈分不过是寻常称呼罢了。无实际血脉羁绊，依年岁尊称长辈，本就无错。”
赢天点点头：
“倒也是这个理。说起来，你数位道侣相伴，想来不止小庸、小溪这一双儿女吧？”
“我还有一名幼子，名唤耀小寒，今年方才四岁，是我与小龙女的孩子。
如今小龙女正带着他在北冥极北寒地潜心苦修。”
赢天打趣道：
“当真令人羡慕。大劫落幕，小师弟一身清闲，看来专门潜心延续薪火了。”
落尘不好意思挠挠头：
“我并未刻意强求子嗣机缘，一切皆是顺其自然。”
“不止是我。我大师兄与千面也诞下一子。
content_en:
Chapter 1974 Drinking in the Medicine Garden
Luochen confessed that Yao Xiaoxi was his and Mirage's biological daughter.
Yingtian gave a thumbs up and sighed sincerely:
"I can't accept the bloodline thing. As expected, the tiger father has no dog daughter, plus the god emperor princess.
Xiaoxi already possesses incredible foundation at a young age. Such qualifications are worthy of your bloodline. "
Luochen's eyes hid a bit of tenderness and doting:
"Xiao Xi's talent is unparalleled among his peers, impeccable.
It's just that Mirage has always been soft-hearted, and she will inevitably spoil her if she is raising a child alone.
It also made Xiaoxi stubborn and fearless. "
"When this girl was six years old, she dared to break into the Dragon Palace alone. Whatever rare treasures or peerless spiritual objects she saw, she insisted on finding out. Even if she got into trouble, she would always be able to speak plausibly. She said that everyone in Tianxuan is equal, and the treasures and resources of the Dragon Palace are shared by all living beings, so naturally she should have a share.
After several twists and turns, the Dragon Emperor was left helpless by her. "
Yingtian was curious:
"Does the Dragon King know her true identity?"
Luochen shook his head gently:
"I don't know. Except for our level of cultivation, no one in the world can see through the original bloodline of my descendants.
The Dragon King only regarded her as a born peerless evildoer, and he was particularly fond of her, and even considered her his granddaughter. "
Yingtian smiled loudly:
"Haha, that's quite an interesting thing."
"Fortunately, the Dragon Emperor is your father-in-law, so the hierarchy is not messed up after all.
But this little girl, seeing Huang Daya, Xiao Zhan and other seniors, opened her mouth to call grandpa, which lowered your seniority. "
Luochen smiled:
"Seniority is just a common title. There is no actual blood bond, and there is nothing wrong with calling elders according to their age."
Yingtian nodded:
"That's the same truth. Speaking of which, you have several Taoist companions accompanying you. I guess it's not just Xiaoyong and Xiaoxi who are accompanying you, right?"
"I also have a young son, named Yao Xiaohan, who is only four years old this year. He is the child of me and Xiao Longnu.
Now Xiao Longnu is taking him to practice hard in the cold land of Beiming. "
Yingtian joked:
"It's really enviable. The catastrophe is over, and my junior brother is free and seems to be focusing on continuing his career."
Luochen scratched his head in embarrassment:
"I didn't deliberately force the opportunity to have an heir, everything just happened naturally."
"It's not just me. My senior brother and Qian Mian also gave birth to a son.
